segments.text: I just inserted the syringe full of ultrasound gel into my vagina to quantify my endometriosis. I just got an MRI done and I had no idea that you can essentially fill up the vaginal cavity with ultrasound gel to get better images of your pelvic area. I've already got diagnosed endometriosis. This is our quantification of this endometriosis.

So, can we see where the lesions are, how big they are, then we'll treat my endometriosis, we'll come back and we'll get this imaging again and we'll be able to see do the lesions shrink, do they progress, do they disappear entirely? So, I'm so excited because I don't think many people realize you can get MRIs for endometriosis. I certainly didn't. I've had symptoms for many years and I had no idea that you didn't have to get surgery to be diagnosed. So, if you're interested in finding out what we figure out with treating my endometriosis and also my results with this MRI, follow along cuz we're going to be sharing it here with you.
